title: CAM-3 motion measurement and coverage report

sections.heading: Record identity
sections.text: Source CAM-3, frames indexed to the plant clock. The incident clip is continuous from 13:00:00 to 13:24:10. Vertical reference marks were surveyed before extraction. This report concerns vertical motion only.

sections.heading: Measured interval
sections.text: Between 13:00:00 and 13:24:00, yoke downward displacement is 40 +/- 1 mm and carrier downward displacement is 0 +/- 1 mm. The defined seated start was visible at 13:00. Post/spreader contact remained visible during this interval. Displacements share the same reference frame and time window.

sections.heading: Release
sections.text: At 13:24:03 the carrier starts downward travel into the pit. The keeper-to-yoke interface and lateral offset are occluded during the release. The clip cannot distinguish transient offset, rotation or local deformation as the keeper-bypass mechanism.

sections.heading: Coverage limits
sections.text: No contact from an overhead crane or its load is visible within the fully covered carrier envelope from 13:00 to 13:24:03. Temporal and spatial resolution are sufficient to detect direct crane/load contact within that envelope during this interval. Coverage does not exclude an earlier disturbance or all conceivable contact outside that envelope. Measurement uncertainty is bounded as stated; it is not a confidence percentage.
